BiblicalUsage: Shechem = "back" or "shoulder"; n pr m; 1) son of Hamor, the chieftain of the Hivites at Shechem at the time of Jacob's arrival; n pr loc; 2) a city in Manasseh; located in a valley between Mount Ebal and Mount Gerizim, 34 miles (54 km) north of Jerusalem and 7 miles (10.5 km) south- east of Samaria
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
